question: Where can I find a park within a 140 kilometers search radius in the northwest direction?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin(parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_Union(geometry)) FROM regions)::geography, 140000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_Union(geometry)) FROM regions), parks.geometry)) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
